items.description: As the Scrum system, I want planned items to be selected into the sprint backlog so that sprint execution starts from committed work.
definitionOfDone: selection result is visible in sprint-state.json

items.title: Formalize sprint planning command
items.description: As the Scrum system, I want a planning command so that the active sprint can be initialized with a formal sprint goal.

items.title: List archived sprint history
items.description: As the Scrum system, I want a history command so that archived sprints can be listed from terminal.

items.title: Inspect archived sprint detail
items.description: As the Scrum system, I want a history-detail command so that a specific archived sprint can be inspected from terminal.
definitionOfDone: specific sprint can be loaded by sprintId

items.title: Improve show output with sprint goal
items.description: As the Scrum system, I want the show command to include sprintGoal so that the active sprint summary is complete.
definitionOfDone: active sprint summary is easier to read

items.title: Prepare real sprint backlog selection for Sprint 003
items.description: As the Scrum system, I want the next real sprint items selected from product backlog so that Sprint 003 can execute committed work.

selected items can be moved into sprint backlog

items.title: Add native sprint backlog selection command
items.description: As the Scrum system, I want a native select command so that planned product backlog items can be loaded into the active sprint without manual Python editing.

items.title: Add automatic product backlog sync on complete
items.description: As the Scrum system, I want completed sprint items to update product-backlog.json automatically so that backlog state stays consistent.
definitionOfDone: matching product backlog item is marked done automatically
missing product backlog item does not break the command

items.title: Add review close command
items.description: As the Scrum system, I want an explicit review-close command so that review state transitions are formalized before retrospective.
definitionOfDone: status and phase move consistently after review
command is visible in sprint flow

items.title: Add retrospective close command
items.description: As the Scrum system, I want an explicit retro-close command so that sprint closure is formalized before next-sprint.
definitionOfDone: completed sprint can be formally closed
